name: Persistent Systems Ltd
about: Persistent Systems provides software engineering and strategy services to help companies implement and modernize their businesses. It has its own software and frameworks with pre-built integration and acceleration [1]. It also has partnership with providers such as Salesforce and AWS [2].
keyPoints: Solutions Offered[1] [2] {# The company is a global digital services and solutions provider specializing in AI-led, platform-driven digital engineering and enterprise modernization. It offers end-to-end capabilities across software and product engineering, data and AI, cloud-enabled enterprise modernization, customer experience (CX) transformation, intelligent automation, and analytics. The company serves diverse industries, including software and high-tech, banking, financial services and insurance (BFSI), and healthcare and life sciences.
pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 35.8% CAGR over last 5 years
Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 25.6%
Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 36.5%
Company's median sales growth is 19.6% of last 10 years
cons: Stock is trading at 11.2 times its book value
Promoter holding has decreased over last quarter: -1.47%
